{{Quote|Designation: SD-9. Mission to retrieve Rakata memory cores failed. Design of Belsavis prison cannot be duplicated.|SD-9|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''SD-9''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], SD-9 was tasked with retrieving the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]] of disabled [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Warlord's Deep]] in [[the Tomb]], but the [[Esh-kha]] destroyed SD-9's escort and damaged the droid. It managed to return to the [[signal monitoring center]], where it communicated its mission to Imperial forces that successfully carried it out.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
SD-9 appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it provides Imperial players with the mission "Droid Malfunction."<ref name="TOR" />
